files.scripts/recent_requests.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
src=$1
count=$2
out=$3
mkdir -p "$(dirname "$out")"
head -n 1 "$src" > "$out"
tail -n +2 "$src" | tail -n "$count" >> "$out"
